lines.en: I move slowly; the column parts.

lines.zh: 我的腹比任何一只都长
lines.en: My abdomen is longer than any other's.
The ones on both sides lower their heads.

lines.zh: 我经过的地方草都伏着
lines.en: The grass lies flat where I pass.
Old patterns mark my shell.

lines.zh: 地面的震动传到我脚下
lines.en: Tremors reach my feet.
I shift forward step by step.
A great host follows behind me.
I stand at the very center of the nest.
All around me are those I bore.

lines.zh: 我不用动，事情会自己办
lines.en: I need not move; things get done.
My antennae turn very slowly.
The temperature here is just right.
I do not eat; they feed me.
My abdomen rises and falls.
A layer of fine grass covers the floor.
I lift my eyes toward the entrance.
I say nothing at all.
This crimson is mine.
I slowly draw my forelegs in.
They are hauling outside.

lines.zh: 我的影子里有两只小的
lines.en: Two young ones sit in my shadow.
I wait; I am not hurried.
I raise my eyes and look far.

lines.zh: 你走到了不该来的地方
lines.en: You have come somewhere you should not.
I need not stand up.
Everyone around me is watching you.

lines.zh: 你身上带着野地的气味
lines.en: You carry the smell of wild ground.
You are shorter than my leg.
You stand there alone.
I watched you long without moving.
My mandibles open once.
There is no place for you here.

lines.zh: 周围的同伴都躁动起来
lines.en: The ones around me grow agitated.
I take half a step back.
My abdomen's side hurts.
I slowly close my mandibles.
They put themselves in front of me.
This is not my first wound.
I am still standing.
You have made this serious.

lines.zh: 他们把东西送到我面前
lines.en: They bring things to my mouth.
Your portion is too small.
I need no offering from you.
Leave it at the entrance.

lines.zh: 我吃的东西要经过检查
lines.en: What I eat is checked first.
Holding it higher will not help.
My children will deal with it.
Withdraw.
I do not look at what you hold.
My body is like a tree stump.

lines.zh: 周围的同伴立刻围上来
lines.en: The ones around close in at once.
I slowly shift my body aside.
We leave marks on the floor.
Half a step back, and I am displeased.
You stepped on my abdomen.
Back off. My colony is watching.

lines.zh: 碰我一下，整窝都会围上来。
lines.en: One touch and the whole nest swarms you.
There is only one of me in this nest.
My mate has long been gone.
I need only this nest.

lines.zh: 他们围着我是因为我是我
lines.en: They circle me because I am me.
That is no concern of yours.
I have borne enough already.
I need no one near.

lines.zh: 这片地会自己长出新的一代
lines.en: This ground will raise a new generation itself.
Your words do not interest me.
I turn away.
They do this for me.
I do not bend.
Leave it there.
My forelegs are not long enough.
Bring it before me.
I touch it once and push it away.
I take nothing belonging to others.
They have carried it away.
You stand in my nest.
I need not call; they will come.
My children have all woken.

lines.zh: 你退到入口也来不及了
lines.en: Reaching the entrance will not save you.
This crimson does not welcome you.
I raise my body.
My abdomen is glowing.
My voice is very low.
This colony was born of me.
They obey me.

lines.zh: 你只有一次机会走出去
lines.en: You have one chance to walk out.
I rear up.
My mandibles open widest.
The way out is already sealed.
Do not move.
They wait on one word from me.
I need not chase you.
They close from every side.
You are retreating inward.

lines.zh: 我腹部的纹路涨得发亮。
lines.en: The markings on my abdomen swell and brighten.
My children are faster than I am.

lines.zh: 你身后的路已经被堵住
lines.en: The way behind you is blocked.
I mark where you stand.

lines.zh: 我抬起一根前腿，他们就动
lines.en: One foreleg raised, and they move.
The grass moves, and it is not wind.
You are against the wall now.
Your breathing is in my ears.
They spread out on both sides of me.
I am patient; I have a whole nest.

lines.zh: 你连站的地方都在缩小
lines.en: Even your standing room is shrinking.
A little closer.
I have stopped.
My mandibles come down.
This time I act myself.
They part; I advance.
My forelegs pin you.
Your armor creaks between my jaws.
I turn and swing my abdomen.
You are shoved to the wall.
I bite and tighten slowly.
My children fill in behind.
That one took everything.
Will you rise again?
I wait with mandibles open.
I withdraw one slow step.
The depths of the nest grow faintly bright.
I come up from the depths.
Every head turns to me.
My abdomen trails behind me.

lines.zh: 空气里全是我们的气味
lines.en: The air is all our scent.
The grass is pressed into a path.
First I look toward the entrance.
The soil under me is soft.
I open my mandibles slowly.
Something has walked in from afar.
My children form a ring.
I rear up, taller than usual.
The crimson falls quiet.

lines.zh: 我闻到了不属于这里的气味
lines.en: I smell something that does not belong.
My shell warms in the dark.
I wait; let them look first.
The tremors in the ground have changed.
Every head turns toward me.
Now. A guest has come.
I move to the exact center.

lines.zh: 火烧到我的腹，边缘卷起
lines.en: Fire reaches my abdomen; the edge curls.
I fall heavily to the floor.

lines.zh: 水从我腹侧的缝里灌进去
lines.en: Water pours in at my abdomen seam.
The blast tears a corner off the nest.
Something sticks in my chest plate.

lines.zh: 那力量钻进我的腹部深处
lines.en: That force reaches deep into my abdomen.
What they feed me is not enough.

lines.zh: 雷落在巢上，我全身收紧
lines.en: Lightning strikes the nest and I clench.

lines.zh: 这里没有巢，也没有他们
lines.en: No nest here, and none of them.
